units: Accumulated downsampled points in the initial map, not scan count
scope: Only startup point threshold differs from the original mapping baseline. Use another isolated saved-bag replay, stationary at startup, same stop gates.
rationale: The initial threshold permits one sparse scan to seed the map. Offline nearest-five plane-screening of a fixed held-out stationary scan accepted 216/357 matches against a 481-point one-scan seed and 357/357 against a 4039-point ten-scan seed. This approximate check does not prove those correspondences are correct or that the estimator will stabilize.
